data.name: Children's Sandbox
data.detailed_description:
Children's Sandbox is a very simple game that was created by parents for their children, and it feels only fair to release this game to others who may want something simple to help children with fine motor and logic skills.

Children's Sandbox is made up of 9 different simple games for children to play. These games help with things as simple as reaction speed, dragging and dropping capabilities, correlation with colors and shapes, memorization, and other skills. Of course, to do this, we need simple games that children will enjoy and not feel "tested" with. Therefore, each of these mini games on their own feel like simple things that children can enjoy on their own without realizing they're building up on skills that may help them early on.

Depending on your child's place with milestones and other various natural factors, this game can probably be played and enjoyed from age 2 to 4. Of course, bare in mind screen time at these young ages - please keep it to a minimum!

The game is made up of three difficulties. Easy tends to slow games down or lower the number of requirements to "meet a goal", where as medium and hard will increase these speeds or number requirements. It's recommended to start on easy, see how your child does, and then change the difficulty to what feels right! Each game may have to be tweaked to different difficulties, depending on where your child is with the respective skill.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel 1.20GHz Dual-Core
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Mouse and Touch Support
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel 2.00GHz Quad-Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support, 2GB
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Mouse and Touch Support
